scripts.export:wp-content: npm run cli rm -- -rf .export/wp-content && mkdir -p .export/wp-content/uploads && run-p export:wp-content:*
scripts.export:db: mkdir -p .export/sql && npm run wp db -- export .export/sql/local.sql
scripts.pretest:php:lint: npm run test:php:start && npm run test-composer install -- --no-interaction
scripts.test:lint:php: npm run test:php:lint || (status=$?; npm run test:php:stop; exit $status)
scripts.pretest:php:unit: npm run test:php:start && npm run test-composer install -- --no-interaction && npm run test-composer install-theme
scripts.test:unit:php: npm run test:php:unit || (status=$?; npm run test:php:stop; exit $status)
scripts.zip:pack: rsync -a --exclude='/vendor' --exclude='/node_modules' --exclude='.*' --exclude='*.config.js' --exclude='*.xml.dist' --exclude='*.ruleset.xml' --exclude='/bin' --exclude='/tests' --exclude='package*.json' . snow-monkey-event-organiser-support && npm run wp-env start && npm run composer install -- --no-interaction --no-dev -d snow-monkey-event-organiser-support
scripts.zip: npm run clean:zip && npm run zip:pack && npm run zip:archive
